front.title: ICMP Error Handling for EVPN-VPWS in SRv6 Networks

abstract.t: This document describes procedures for handling ICMP error messages for Ethernet VPN Virtual Private Wire Service (EVPN-VPWS) in Segment Routing over IPv6 (SRv6) networks. It describes an ingress-PE approach that associates a received ICMPv6 error with the EVPN service, constructs eligible customer ICMP feedback, and uses local End.DX2 disposition to apply the appropriate Ethernet and VLAN treatment. The discussion covers IPv4 and IPv6 customer traffic, the handling of the different ICMP error classes, and the additional procedures applicable to Packet Too Big messages and Path MTU Discovery.
